coverage: Reported lending categories and unassigned income and costs
definition: Income less borrowing costs, charges for expected loan losses, staff and other expenses. Tax and the group’s share of results from jointly controlled businesses come afterwards.
incomeDefinition: Interest, fees and commissions, other operating gains and other income. Money lent out and repaid is not income.
sourceLabel: Audited annual report · group segment note
location: PDF pages 325–326 (printed 313–314), consolidated note 39; PDF page 277 (printed 265), consolidated profit and loss; 30 April results filing, note 5
notes: Total income includes ₹465.63 crore of other income. Unallocable is income and costs not assigned to a lending category; there is no separate internal-income deduction in this table. Vehicle Finance is the largest reported contributor. The year includes ₹49.65 crore of added employee benefit expense under new labour laws and a separate ₹200 crore allowance chosen by management for possible loan losses linked to geopolitical risks. A ₹38.75 crore earlier-year tax adjustment reduced tax expense. The group’s profit after tax and its share of jointly controlled businesses was ₹5,232.61 crore.
insight: Vehicle loans bring in the most income and profit before tax. Loans against property earn the next-largest result and include a gain recorded when loans were transferred. Others combines several loan types; the table does not tell us the separate profit on gold loans.
